notes.title: 🔥 Wishlist Our New RPG 'MAMA' – MILFs vs. Monsters!
notes.notes:
Hey fans!

Loved our previous games? Then you're going to LOVE our newest title, MAMA—a thrilling, sexy, action-packed RPG set in an alternative Cold War era.

In 1983, Soviet scientists drilled deep beneath Earth's surface and unleashed literal hell. Now, an elite global task force of stunning married operatives—known as MAMA—must fight back against these terrifying monsters. It's a battle for humanity's survival, wrapped in explosive combat, seductive scenarios, and gripping storytelling.

Here's what to expect:

⚔️ Dynamic RPG Combat: Equip and strategize your agents against monstrous foes.

💋 Sexy MILF Characters: Choose from beautiful, cunning, and deadly operatives.

🔥 Intense Adult Scenes: Unlock alluring, high-quality CG scenes as you play.

🌎 Immersive Lore & Exploration: Discover secrets hidden deep within enemy territories across the globe.

🎨 Anime-inspired Art & Design: Stunning visuals from acclaimed artists.

MAMA is now available to wishlist on Steam, and a free playable demo is already LIVE!

👇 Don't wait—Wishlist NOW! 👇
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209850/MAMA

Thanks for your continued support—we can’t wait for you to play!

– PUSH! Team

notes.title: Major October Update
notes.notes: Welcome everyone to the OCTOBER UPDATE for Usagi Health Club! This major update contains major bug fixes, grammatical error fixed and and an added feature where you can now browse through the CG variants instead of just only able to see the first CG while unlocked.
